# Jamery Wang — Personal Site

## Projects

- [XhsGrowthAgent](https://www.jameryw.dev/project.html?slug=xhs-growth-agent) — Growth Agent · Active · 2026-05-31. Xiaohongshu growth workbench: a deterministic Kernel owns state and scheduling, LangGraph only runs the task graph, and publishing stays human-gated.
- [QuantAgent](https://www.jameryw.dev/project.html?slug=quant-agent) — Quant Agent · Active research · 2026-05-31. A heuristic agent framework where executable code is the policy — not neural weights — so iteration is learning and tests are memory.
- [RealQuantEngine](https://www.jameryw.dev/project.html?slug=real-quant-engine) — Quant Engine · Active · 2026-05-31. A modular quant strategy library — multi-strategy orchestration, broker adapters, and risk controls, with Futu live trading and dry-run.
- [QuantStrategyPrototypes](https://www.jameryw.dev/project.html?slug=quant-strategy-prototypes) — Strategy Lab · Archive · 2026-05-31. Quant strategy prototypes grounded in arXiv research — backtest engine, 10 strategy modules, and 91% test coverage. Archived; strategy surface folded into RealQuantEngine.
- [UltimateCoders](https://www.jameryw.dev/project.html?slug=ultimate-coders) — Distributed AI · Active · 2026-06-11. Distributed AI coding platform: DAG orchestration, observable Dashboard, multi-adapter Workers, shared layered memory and hybrid retrieval.
- [AwesomeWorkflows](https://www.jameryw.dev/project.html?slug=awesome-workflows) — Agent Workflows · Active · 2026-09-03. Issue-driven delivery workflows reusable across Codex / Claude Code / Grok Build / DeepSeek Harness — Matt Pocock engineering skills plus the Trellis task lifecycle.

## Notes

- [Why Agents Matter](https://www.jameryw.dev/note.html?slug=why-agents-matter) — Agents · Current lens · 2026-05-31. I care more about continuous execution, memory, and tool collaboration than about polished single-turn answers.
- [Prototype First](https://www.jameryw.dev/note.html?slug=prototype-first) — Build · Working rule · 2026-05-31. Get it running first, then let the real problems surface. Many judgments only hold once the interface and the scripts work together.
- [Interface as Signal](https://www.jameryw.dev/note.html?slug=interface-as-signal) — Interface · Ongoing principle · 2026-05-31. Interface choices reveal technical understanding and product judgment, so the site itself should be part of the work.
- [Prompt Engineering Is Evolving](https://www.jameryw.dev/note.html?slug=prompt-engineering-evolution) — Prompt · 2025 observation · 2026-05-31. Prompt engineering is shifting from handcrafted tricks to structured interfaces — from writing prompts to designing tools and orchestrating flows.
- [Build In Public](https://www.jameryw.dev/note.html?slug=build-in-public) — Philosophy · Ongoing practice · 2026-05-31. Building in public isn't performance — it turns the iteration process itself into signal, making ability, judgment, and execution directly verifiable.
- [Productivity & Production Relations](https://www.jameryw.dev/note.html?slug=productivity-and-relations) — Org · 2025 observation · 2026-06-09. Productive forces determine production relations: organizations that match new productive forces with old forms will ultimately be replaced by a more radically efficient form.
- [Evolve In Loop](https://www.jameryw.dev/note.html?slug=evolve-in-loop) — Loop · Ongoing practice · 2026-06-10. Evolution isn't a one-time leap but the accumulation of countless closed feedback loops. Each loop is a calibration: act, feedback, adjust, act again.
- [Quantity Becomes Quality](https://www.jameryw.dev/note.html?slug=quantity-to-quality) — Alpha · 2025 observation · 2026-06-26. Sustained high-quality data produces high-quality strategies, and high-quality strategies spawn new alpha. It's a self-reinforcing flywheel, not linear accumulation.
- [Knowledge Depreciates, Experience Appreciates](https://www.jameryw.dev/note.html?slug=knowledge-depreciates-experience-appreciates) — Judgment · 2025 observation · 2026-07-02. AI rapidly depreciates retrievable knowledge while appreciating engineering experience earned from real failures. Designing distributed architectures that survive hundred-million-scale concurrency takes more than textbook basics.
- [Skills Devoured, Tools Fortified](https://www.jameryw.dev/note.html?slug=skills-devoured-tools-fortified) — Moat · 2025 observation · 2026-07-13. The stronger models get, the more pure-software skills get devoured like free APIs. Truly hard to replicate are tools that touch the physical world — sensors, actuators, private protocols, real-environment feedback loops.
- [Pure Software Devalued, Physical Integration Premium](https://www.jameryw.dev/note.html?slug=pure-software-devalued-physical-premium) — Value · 2025 observation · 2026-09-22. Large models keep internalizing pure-software capability into free infrastructure, while software-hardware integration tied to the physical world appreciates on the back of real-world data loops.
- [K-Shaped Divergence In The AI Era](https://www.jameryw.dev/note.html?slug=ai-k-shaped-divergence) — Divergence · 2025 observation · 2026-10-21. AI splits the world into a K: apps go liberal-arts — taste and character decide who wins; tech goes hardcore — hardware bound to the physical world, perception–action–feedback in real environments, and self-evolution.
